groups.title: iCarly main cast
groups.def: The five characters whose actors get starring billing in iCarly's opening credits (2007-2012): Carly, Sam, Freddie, Spencer and Gibby (recurring in seasons 1-3, starring from season 4); every other iCarly character in the pool is recurring.

groups.title: iCarly's recurring adults
groups.def: Adult iCarly characters billed as recurring, never starring (2007-2012): Freddie's mom Marissa, doorman Lewbert, T-Bo, teachers Ms. Briggs and Mr. Howard, and Principal Franklin; Spencer is starring cast and Nevel, Chuck and Guppy are kids.

groups.title: Victorious main cast
groups.def: The seven characters whose actors get starring billing in Victorious's opening credits (Tori, Trina, André, Robbie, Jade, Cat, Beck) plus Robbie's puppet Rex, performed by billed star Matt Bennett and listed by the wiki as a main character; Sikowitz, Lane, Sinjin and the other adults are recurring.

groups.title: Victorious's recurring adults
groups.def: Adult Victorious characters billed as recurring: acting teacher Sikowitz, guidance counselor Lane, Tori's dad David Vega and Grub Truck owner Festus; Helen appears in only one Victorious episode ('Helen Back Again'), so she's a guest here, and this group never shares a board with her D&J groups.

groups.title: Hollywood Arts students
groups.def: Characters enrolled as students at Hollywood Arts during Victorious: Tori, Trina, André, Robbie, Jade, Cat, Beck and Sinjin; Robbie's puppet Rex is left out (same family, so never on its boards) and staff (Sikowitz, Lane, Festus, Helen) don't count.

groups.title: Drake & Josh main cast
groups.def: The five characters whose actors get starring billing on Drake & Josh (and in Merry Christmas, Drake & Josh): Drake, Josh, Megan, their mom Audrey and stepdad Walter; Helen, Crazy Steve, Gavin, Mrs. Hayfer, Mindy, Craig and Eric are recurring.

groups.title: Drake & Josh's recurring adults
groups.def: Adult Drake & Josh characters billed as recurring: Premiere manager Helen, Premiere workers Crazy Steve and Gavin, and English teacher Mrs. Hayfer; Audrey and Walter are starring cast and Mindy, Craig and Eric are teen classmates.

groups.title: Big Time Rush main cast
groups.def: The seven characters whose actors get starring billing on Big Time Rush: Kendall, James, Carlos, Logan, Katie, Gustavo, and Kelly (recurring in season 1, starring from season 2); Mrs. Knight, Jo, Camille, Lucy and the other Palm Woods characters are recurring.

groups.title: BTR's recurring characters
groups.def: Big Time Rush characters billed as recurring and never as starring: Mrs. Knight, Mr. Bitters, Griffin (Gustavo's boss; tagged BTR because iCarly has its own recurring Griffin), Buddha Bob, Jo, Camille and Lucy; Kelly was recurring only in season 1 before joining the starring cast, so she's out.

groups.title: Big Time Rush (the band)
groups.def: The four teenagers who form the boy band Big Time Rush in the show: Kendall, James, Carlos and Logan, as opposed to their family, friends or the adults at the label.

groups.title: Teachers
groups.def: Characters whose job is teaching classes at a school during the original runs: Ms. Briggs and Mr. Howard (Ridgeway), Sikowitz (Hollywood Arts) and Mrs. Hayfer (Belleview); principals Franklin and Helen and counselor Lane don't teach, Trina only teaches in the later Hollywood Arts spin-off, and Josh student-taught Megan's class once ('Megan's New Teacher'), so this group avoids every group holding Josh or Lane.
avoid: Big brother or sister of a main character
Shares a first name with their actor

groups.title: Little sister of a main character
groups.def: The younger sister of a starring-billed character on her own show: Carly (Spencer), Tori (Trina), Megan (Drake, and stepbrother Josh), Katie (Kendall); siblings who aren't starring cast don't count (Sam's twin Melanie, Cat's brother, Chuck's brother Chip), and Guppy is Gibby's little brother, not sister.

groups.title: Played by Miranda Cosgrove or Jerry Trainor
groups.def: Characters played by Miranda Cosgrove (Megan Parker, Carly Shay) or Jerry Trainor (Crazy Steve, Spencer Shay); their cameos as themselves or as uncredited extras aren't tiles.

groups.title: Younger than the teen leads
groups.def: Characters introduced as pre-teens, clearly younger than their own show's teen leads: Nevel (11 in season 1), Chuck and Guppy (iCarly), Megan (9-10 in season 1) and Katie (9-10 in season 1); Nevel, Chuck, Megan and Katie reach their early teens later, so this group never shares a board with 'Recurring teens'.

groups.title: Recurring teens
groups.def: Teenage characters billed as recurring (never starring) who are the same age as their show's teen leads: Sinjin, Mindy, Craig, Eric, Jo, Camille and Lucy (18 when introduced); younger kids Nevel and Chuck and Gibby (recurring before starring from iCarly season 4) are kept off its boards by avoid links.

groups.title: Parent of a teen lead
groups.def: A parent or step-parent of a teenage starring character on their show: Marissa (Freddie), David Vega (Tori, Trina), Audrey (Drake, Megan; Josh's stepmom), Walter (Josh, Megan; Drake's stepdad), Mrs. Knight (Kendall, Katie); Spencer is Carly's brother and guardian, Griffin's and Franklin's daughters are guests, Buddha Bob's 'Big Time Wedding' marriage to Mrs. Knight was void, and Lewbert only marries Marissa in the revival.

groups.title: Big brother or sister of a main character
groups.def: The older brother or sister (step-siblings included) of a starring character on their show: Spencer (Carly), Trina (Tori), Drake and Josh (Megan), Kendall (Katie); Gibby's little brother Guppy and Sinjin's sister Courtney aren't starring cast.

groups.title: Shares a first name with their actor
groups.def: The character's first name is exactly their actor's credited first name: Kendall (Kendall Schmidt), James (James Maslow), Carlos (Carlos Pena), Drake (Drake Bell), Josh (Josh Peck), Lane (Lane Napper); Tori (never confirmed on screen as 'Victoria') and Logan (real name Hortense, 'Big Time Moms') are out, and the groups holding Tori never share its boards.
avoid: Little sister of a main character

groups.title: Belleview High students
groups.def: Students at Belleview High School on Drake & Josh: Drake, Josh, Mindy, Craig and Eric; Megan attends the same building's lower (middle) school, so this group never shares a board with Megan's groups, and Mrs. Hayfer teaches there.
avoid: Little sister of a main character
Played by Miranda Cosgrove or Jerry Trainor

groups.title: Worked at the Premiere
groups.def: Worked at the Premiere, the movie theater on Drake & Josh: manager Helen, Josh, Drake (hired in 'Movie Job'), Mindy (assistant manager), Gavin and Crazy Steve; Megan only sold her Cup-O-Stuff idea to Helen for royalties ('Helen's Surgery') and never worked there.
